item.title: Respect the Crit — Empire's Edge — Empire's Edge - Ep. 01: Empire's Edge
item.description:
Original publisher: Respect the Crit — Empire's Edge. It is a period of uncertainty and fear. The Clone Wars are over, the Jedi are destroyed, and the newly formed GALACTIC EMPIRE controls the galaxy through oppression and tyranny. In this dark era, the lone droid LO-RNA returns with their recently deceased master to the planet Bothawui, home world of the Bothan species and their infamous espionage network. Bound by a sombre duty to their late owner, the droid Elo is compelled to take on one final task.

item.title: Force Majeure — Coldfire Chronicles S01 E08 - A Daring Escape!
item.itunes:title: Force Majeure — Coldfire Chronicles S01 E08 - A Daring Escape!
item.description:
Original publisher: Force Majeure.

With Pyjak freed from his cell and out of Imperial hands, all that's left to do is escape from the base without being killed by Stormtroopers, unravel the mysteries of their mentor, work out exactly what Coldfire's Mercy is and get off planet before Tenth Brother arrives. And do this before their cups of tea go cold.

Easy, right?

Presenting Episode 8 of the Coldfire Chronicles.

Follow us on social media!

Twitter: @forcemajeurepod
Instagram: forcemajeurepod
Online: www.forcemajeurepod.com
Email: forcemajeurepod@gmail.com

Worse yet, this strange world may be a hideout for smugglers and bounty hunters who have ties to the Empire. New to the Trsy, Leenik, and Bacta's escapades?
